title: : "Unilateral Travel Ban Without Due Process — 'Cierta Categoria Donde No Puede Viajar Con Nosotros'"

confidence.derivation_formula: value = round( sum_per_article( applicability_weight × element_grid.weighted_score ) / sum_of_weights × authorities_verification_factor, 2 ); authorities_verification_factor = 0.85 + 0.15 × verified_ratio = 0.850

allegation_summary: STG-29 SEG 122 and json_latam_STG_2 SEG 16 record LATAM staff stating that the passenger has been placed in 'cierta categoria donde no puede viajar con nosotros' — a unilateral, undocumented travel ban imposed by a private carrier without any due-process instrument: no written decision, no statement of grounds, no appeal channel, no statutory authority. The 'category' is communicated verbally and is referenced again in the next-day boarding denial chain (CL-006). Combined with the fact that the underlying allegations were already disproven by PDI, the ban is ultra vires and an arbitrary act in the sense of CONST Art. 19.2 and Art. 19.3, and a defective service under LPDC Art. 23.
evidentiary_strength: On-tape verbal imposition + cross-day corroboration with CL-006.

legal_basis.article_name: Codigo Aeronautico de Chile, Art. 133 — Travel Ban Sin Debido Proceso
legal_basis.applicability_rationale: A unilateral, undocumented 'cierta categoria' travel ban imposed on a consumer by a private carrier without statutory authority, written decision, statement of grounds, or appeal channel is ultra vires and arbitrary under CONST Art. 19.2/19.3. | legacy paraphrase: Denegacion de Embarque — En caso de denegacion de embarque, el transportador debera ofrecer al pasajero, a su eleccion: (a) embarque en el siguiente vuelo disponible; (b) reembolso del precio del billete; o (c) transporte de retorno al punto de origen. Ademas, debera pagar una compensacion monetaria minima conforme a la tabla del numeral 2 del mismo articulo.
legal_basis.verbatim_text: En el evento que el transportador prevea que tendra que denegar el embarque de uno o mas pasajeros por sobreventa, los cuales se hubieren presentado oportunamente y cuyo billete de pasaje estuviere previamente confirmado en un vuelo determinado, debera pedir en primer lugar que se presenten voluntarios que renuncien a sus reservas a cambio de determinadas prestaciones y reparaciones que se acuerden entre los voluntarios y el transportador.

legal_reasoning:
**Applicable Framework**: CACH Art. 133 + LPDC Art. 23/23 bis + CONST Art. 19.1.

**Factual Subsumption**: STG-29 SEG 122 announces the 'categoria' verbally; the same ban is referenced again the next day (cf. CL-006 boarding denial chain).

**Nexus Fact Norm**: Private-carrier travel restrictions require due process; an undocumented verbal ban does not.

**Evidentiary Strength**: On-tape verbal imposition + cross-day corroboration with CL-006.

**Severity Assessment**: HIGH.

**Procedural Integrity**: Compliant with Ontology Invariant I-1.
